name: cleanroom_r2e_reaction_center_bounded_residual_v3
purpose: Test whether a fixed geometry cap can retain the pre-existing low-similarity reaction-center benefit while more strictly preserving the proven RDKit+ base representation. Internal-only development; revealed outer benchmarks cannot select candidates or gates.

development_split.split_type: strict protein+reaction entity-disjoint deterministic salted hash double-cold

candidate_family.bound_definition: per reaction before GELU: norm(aux_hidden_after_projection) <= cap * norm(frozen_base_hidden_preactivation)
candidate_family.candidate_derivation: rounded clean2023-train-only predecessor p25/p50/p90 hidden residual ratios; no outer performance used

selection.primary_capability_slice: reaction_similarity_lt0p3 using the pre-existing binary-DRFP train-similarity definition
selection.candidate_order_tiebreak: prefer smaller max_residual_ratio if all registered selection metrics tie
per_candidate_pooled_required: lt0p3 MRR strictly improves over matching fresh base
lt0p3 macro AUROC does not regress
selection.fold_stability: lt0p3 MRR and MAP must both improve in at least 2/3 development folds; neither may regress by >0.005 in any fold
strict_all_query_preservation: pooled all-query MRR does not regress
pooled all-query MAP does not regress
pooled all-query NDCG@10 does not regress
pooled all-query Hit@10 does not regress
pooled all-query Hit@20 does not regress
pooled all-query Hit@50 does not regress
selection.if_none_pass: reject bounded-residual-v3; do not try a new cap on the same development split
selection.if_one_passes: freeze that exact cap and run only the already frozen future_confirmation_split
